note: Floor footprints the eligibility engine uses to test physical fit. DESIGN STANDARD values (rules.json D-MODULE-SIZES): they decide whether requested items fit, never whether a build is legal. 'length' runs along the vehicle (along a wall), 'depth' runs across it from the wall. kind: wall = stands against one side wall; seat = one travel seat against a side (pairs face each other across the aisle); zero_floor = no floor area of its own (overhead, under furniture, roof or wall mounted). 'source' says where each size comes from: CATALOG = data/components.json (with its own sources and confidence), RENDER = scaled off Force's Urbania 16+D render, HANDOVER-GLB = the handover's GLB build rule, DESIGN DEFAULT = ObjectWeave planning default with no product drawing behind it yet (replace with the supplier's drawing). BUILDER_SPEC = taken from a body builder's product sheet or dimensioned layout (data/builders/).

cab_passenger_seats.basis: The handover GLBs and Force's Urbania render both have a driver and one co-driver seat in the cab. One of the two Azad Urbania layouts shows a 2-seat co-driver sofa in the cab (data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf p.2); 1 is kept as the conservative default.

occupant_mass_kg.basis: Standard passenger mass used for payload notes only.

standard.basis: Seat width 420 mm and row pitch 780 mm measured on the Force Urbania 16+D render (±50 mm).

captain.basis: Larger than the Urbania cab seat on the render (480 wide × 710 deep) plus legroom. Replace with the supplier's drawing.

recliner.basis: Reclining seat with leg room for the reclined position. Replace with the supplier's drawing.

massage_recliner.basis: Azad Automotive Customs 'VIP electric recliner, Business Class A' (massager, ventilation, 3-point belt, calf support; 360° swivel option): 64 cm wide × 64 cm deep × 103.5 cm high, 150 cm fully reclined (data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf p.5). Pitch 1118 mm = 26 in seat + 18 in gap between rows on the builder's layout (p.3). Powered: counts as a living-electrics load.

sofa_cum_bed_2.label: Sofa-cum-bed for 2
sofa_cum_bed_2.basis: Bed length and deployed width = the double-berth minimum (rules.json D-BERTH-SIZE); 600 mm sofa depth. Deployed, it may take the aisle, not the furniture opposite.

washroom_spacious.label: Washroom, spacious (toilet, basin, shower tray)
washroom_spacious.basis: Compact cubicle enlarged for a separate shower tray.

kitchenette.label: Kitchenette counter
kitchenette.basis: data/components.json kitchenette footprint (estimated_from_import); fridge under the counter as in the catalog; microwave in the locker above.

pantry_small.label: Small pantry (tall food cupboard)
pantry_small.basis: Tall cupboard; AIS-124 cl. 4.4(d) wants food stored apart from cooking vessels. Holds the fridge and microwave like the Azad pantry station (data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf p.15).

fridge_small.label: Small 12 V fridge
fridge_small.basis: data/components.json fridge (Dometic CRX 50, 380 × 500); free-standing size used only when there is no counter to put it under.

microwave.label: Microwave
microwave.basis: Built into the pantry or the locker over the counter; its own cabinet only when neither exists.

wardrobe.label: Wardrobe
wardrobe.basis: Storage_Wardrobe_Tall, 600 × 550 mm, in the handover build_camper.py.

removable_table.label: Removable / folding table
removable_table.basis: Permanent floor or wall mount at the sofa; the table itself may detach or fold (AIS-124 cl. 4.1(c)). Uses the aisle only when set up.

overhead_lockers.label: Overhead lockers
overhead_lockers.basis: Above furniture along the walls; reduces headroom over that furniture only.

under_seat_storage.label: Under-seat / under-floor storage
under_seat_storage.basis: Inside the sofa, bed or bench bases.

fresh_water_tank.label: Fresh-water tank, 100 L
fresh_water_tank.basis: data/components.json water_tank; fits inside a sofa or bed base.

grey_tank.label: Grey-water tank
grey_tank.basis: Underslung. Space under the floor and its effect on ground clearance are not checked (no chassis drawing).

black_tank.label: Black-water storage
black_tank.basis: Underslung tank, or the toilet's own cassette.

electrical_cabinet.label: Electrical cabinet (inverter, LiFePO4 battery, fuses, 230 V inlet)
electrical_cabinet.basis: data/components.json electrical_panel, 400 × 200 mm, wall-mounted above other furniture.

seat_back_tablets.label: Seat-back tablets
seat_back_tablets.basis: On the backs of forward-facing seats.

roof_ac.label: Roof air-conditioner
roof_ac.basis: Roof unit; excluded from overall height for M-category vehicles (CMVR Rule 93, Explanation III).

water_heater.label: Water heater
water_heater.basis: Inside the washroom or under the counter.

zero_floor_misc.label: Small fittings
zero_floor_misc.basis: GPS, charging ports, driver–passenger intercom, barbecue points, net connectivity, monitoring unit: no floor area.

sofa_cum_bed_transverse.label: 3-seat sofa-cum-bed across the rear (sleeps 1)
sofa_cum_bed_transverse.basis: Azad layout: '3 Str Sofa cum Bed for 1 pax', 36 in deep made up as a bed, 24 in as a sofa, across the full width (data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf p.3). Berth length = living width.

sofa_2_partition.label: 2-seat sofa at the partition (electric)
sofa_2_partition.basis: Azad: 2-seater sofa next to the partition wall, approx. 15 in (p.7; 20 in on the second layout, p.3), with safe locker and storage (data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-royale_urbania-4400_aug-2026.pdf p.9). Depth across the vehicle is not dimensioned: about 900 mm scaled off the drawing (ESTIMATED).

washroom_builder.label: Washroom, Azad (electric WC, basin)
washroom_builder.basis: Azad: washroom 30 in long at the rear, about half the width, waste and fresh-water tanks underneath, manual door; Vetus electric WC and washbasin (data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf p.2, p.11; data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-royale_urbania-4400_aug-2026.pdf p.6). Depth 825 mm = half of the 1651 mm internal width (ESTIMATED from 'about half').

pantry_builder.label: Pantry station, Azad (fridge, microwave, kettle, storage)
pantry_builder.basis: Azad pantry: 50 L (or 25 L top-opening) compressor fridge, microwave, kettle drawer, small storage on top (data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf p.15; data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-royale_urbania-4400_aug-2026.pdf p.6). Footprint not dimensioned: about 23 × 20 in scaled off the layout (p.2), ESTIMATED.

amenity_map.note: Questionnaire and state-overlay ids → catalog modules. A list means all of them.

law_minimum_fill.note: Smallest module the engine adds when a legal minimum item (rules.json L-MC-MIN-EQUIP) is missing from the request.

amenity_variants.note: A generic request the engine may meet with any of these modules; it keeps whichever fits best.
